brief.title: What the Rain Remembers
brief.premise: A seed-keeper's caravan must cross three recovering valley towns before the last frost, trading grain stock and mending an old feud that split the seedway routes.
constraints: Technology is pre-industrial salvaged hand-tools; nothing powered remains.

world.name: The Seedways
world.description: Generations after the Blight Year emptied the fields, valley towns survive on shared seed stock hauled by caravan along the seedway routes between the last granary and the first orchards.

locations.name: Granary Hill
locations.description: Terraced seed-vaults cut into the hill, where the tithe grain is graded and sealed.

locations.name: Ford Market
locations.description: The river-crossing market where the seedways meet and the weigh-house keeps the tithe ledgers.

locations.name: The Ash Orchards
locations.description: Replanting rows on blight-ash soil, tended by families who took the worst land first.

locations.name: The Frost Gate
locations.description: The high pass that closes on the last frost and strands whatever is caught beyond it.

factions.name: The Seed Keepers
factions.description: A caravan order sworn to grade, seal and carry seed stock between the valleys.

factions.name: The Millers' Compact
factions.description: The town millers who weigh tithe grain and hold the market charters.

factions.name: The Orchard Families
factions.description: The planters who took the blight-ash land and are owed grafting stock by the vaults.

rules.statement: Every town that draws from the seed vaults returns two measures at harvest for each measure taken.
No powered machinery survived the Blight; all work is done by hand, beast and water.
The Frost Gate closes on the last frost; a caravan caught beyond it winters alone.
A keeper who adulterates seed stock is struck from the rolls and their name is never carried by the caravans again.

history.name: The Blight Year
history.description: The blight emptied the fields; survivors sealed the first vaults on Granary Hill.

history.name: The First Seedway
history.description: The first caravan circuit joined the three valleys and made the tithe system possible.

history.name: The Millers' Split
history.description: A falsified tithe ledger at Ford Market split the routes for a generation.

conflicts.name: The Cut Grain
conflicts.description: Someone is diluting tithe grain with chaff at the weigh-house, and the keepers and millers each blame the other.

conflicts.name: The Orchard Claims
conflicts.description: The orchard families claim vault grain promised to them is being carried to the caravan instead.

characters.name: Tove Marka
characters.description: A seed-keeper of the vault caravan, raised on the routes, who grades grain by eye and counts winters like coin.
characters.motivation: To see the seedways whole again before she hands on her satchel.
characters.goal: Reach Ford Market with sound stock before the last frost.
characters.flaw: She carries the whole route alone and will not be helped.
characters.internal_conflict: Mending the split means trusting the people who broke it.
characters.external_conflict: The cut tithe grain makes every town suspect her caravan.

abilities.name: Seed-scoring
abilities.description: Judges germination and adulteration in a sack of grain by eye and weight.

characters.arc: Tove learns that a route no one else can walk is a route that dies with her.

characters.name: Alder Vane
characters.description: The compact factor at Ford Market who diluted the tithe grain to keep his town's mill turning through a hard year.
characters.motivation: To protect his town from an audit that would starve it.
characters.goal: Conceal the diluted tithe until after the thaw audit.
characters.flaw: He believes a debt concealed is a debt half-paid.
characters.internal_conflict: He knows the orchard families paid for his town's lie.
characters.external_conflict: Tove's inspection can read the chaff in his sacks.

abilities.name: Weigh-house politics
abilities.description: Reads markets, credit and debtors well enough to move a ledger without leaving fingerprints.

characters.arc: Vane must confess the cut grain or watch the routes close around him.

characters.name: Nuna Brack
characters.description: An orchard daughter who grafts blight-hardy stock and carries her family's claim to the promised grain.
characters.motivation: To win the grafting stock her family's orchard was promised.
characters.goal: Make the caravan honour the orchard claims before the frost.
characters.flaw: She presses her claim so hard it sounds like a threat.
characters.internal_conflict: She distrusts every keeper yet needs this caravan.
characters.external_conflict: The caravan and the millers both call her claim premature.

abilities.name: Graft-keeping
abilities.description: Keeps grafted stock alive through cold snaps and rough travel.

characters.arc: Nuna wins her stock by helping the caravan prove the fraud that cheated it.

relationships.description: Nuna rides with the caravan to press the orchard claim.
relationships.conflict: Tove cannot honour the claim until the tithe fraud is proven.

relationships.description: Tove's seed-scoring can expose Vane's diluted tithe.
relationships.conflict: Vane must stall her inspection past the frost.

storyboard.title: What the Rain Remembers
storyboard.logline: A seed-keeper carries sound stock and a buried fraud across three valleys before the frost, and mends the split that broke the seedways.

scenes.title: Chaff in the Sacks
scenes.summary: Sealing the tithe sacks at Granary Hill, Tove scores the grain and finds chaff cut into the Ford Market delivery.
scenes.conflict: Reporting the cut grain accuses the market that feeds the routes.
scenes.outcome: Tove seals the evidence and carries it with the caravan.

scenes.title: The Last Circuit
scenes.summary: The caravan departs for the last circuit before the Frost Gate closes, with Tove riding guard on the suspect sacks.
scenes.goal: Reach Ford Market before the frost.
scenes.conflict: Every day lost to weather is a day the gate is nearer shut.
scenes.outcome: The caravan takes the long seedway through the orchards.

scenes.title: The Orchard Claim
scenes.summary: At the Ash Orchards, Nuna demands the promised grafting stock; Tove shows her the cut grain that is starving both claims.
scenes.goal: Pass the orchards without forfeiting stock.
scenes.conflict: Nuna's claim is just, but the caravan's grain is already spoken for.
scenes.outcome: Nuna joins the caravan to see the fraud proven and her claim honoured.

scenes.title: The Weigh-House
scenes.summary: At Ford Market, Alder Vane stalls the audit with courtesy and credit, while Tove scores the market sacks and finds the same cut grain.
scenes.goal: Prove the tithe was diluted at the market.
scenes.conflict: Vane's charter lets him delay any audit past the frost.
scenes.outcome: Tove finds the proof; Vane calls the caravan's own honesty into question.

scenes.title: Before the Gate
scenes.summary: With the true ledger seized and the frost closing, Tove races Vane's hired riders to the Frost Gate to put the evidence beyond the market's reach.
scenes.goal: Carry the true ledger through the gate.
scenes.conflict: Vane needs the evidence lost before the thaw audit.
scenes.outcome: The caravan clears the gate at last light; the ledger is safe in the vault towns.

scenes.title: The Rejoined Routes
scenes.summary: At the thaw audit, the tithe is honestly weighed, the orchards receive their grafting stock, and the split routes are rejoined under one ledger.
scenes.goal: Settle the tithe and the claims.
scenes.conflict: Confessing the fraud costs Vane's town its winter credit.
scenes.outcome: The routes are rejoined; the seedways run whole for the first time in a generation.

evidence_summary: The world, cast and storyboard satisfy the brief's hand-tool seedway setting; deterministic validators are clean and there are no blocking defects.
